newsitem.title: UK: Zeneca, Amersham in technology link.
newsitem.headline: Zeneca, Amersham in technology link.

text.p: British bioscience company Zeneca Group Plc said on Thursday it had formed a gene technology partnership with Amersham International Plc of Britain and Molecular Dynamics Inc of the U.S. In a statement Zeneca said it would join a technology access programme set up by the other two companies aimed at developing high-speed tests and reagents for gene analysis.
It said work on establishing gene functions and links was "expected to contribute significantly to new drug and diagnostic discovery and development."
Zeneca said the alliance was "a further important step in Zeneca's unfolding strategy to exploit genome-based technologies and informatics".

The company said the link was the sixth alliance with biotech companies and academic centres announced in the past year. Zeneca already uses high-speed drug screening technology developed by Amersham in its research.
